title: Artist-Invites-Artists (AIA) Wood Kiln Firing Groups
source_quote: Artist-Invites-Artists Groups Summer 2027... for all wood fire AIA groups from Sept 2027 through April 2028
evidence_sentence: The residency info page states artists must apply through the Artist-Invites-Artists (AIA) program to fire wood kilns during their residency.
evidence_quote: any artist who is interested in firing a wood kiln (either the catenary arch, or train kiln) will need to apply with a group of artists under the "Artist Invites Artists" or "AIA" application portal
summary: Groups of artists can fire the wood kilns (catenary arch or train kiln) during a residency by applying through the AIA program. Applications for Summer 2027 groups (Sept 2027–April 2028 firing) open February 1, 2027. No firing allowed May 1–October 15.
how_to_join: Apply as a group through the Artist-Invites-Artists application portal (opens Feb 1, 2027 for Summer 2027 groups)
